_about: the BANANA (Musa): no tree but a giant herb -- a soft green stem of tight rolled leaf sheaths, blotched brown; a crown of huge paddle leaves, bright green with a pale midrib, torn by the wind into strips along their veins; its bunch (crown.bunch, grown as bodies of its own) bowing out of the crown and hanging, hands of fingers curving up, the bare rachis on down to a purple bud
